text.description_html:
234" Track Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit For Two Doors

This Stainless Steel 234 Inch Barn Door Kit for 2 - 60 Inch Double Converging Doors comes with everything you need to install a sliding door. It comes packaged with a 234 track that is suitable for hanging two wood doors. The SIG510 kit includes a stainless steel ball bearing wheel assembly to ensure an ultra-smooth, nearly silent operation. This sliding door mounting kit has an oil rubbed bronze finish over satin stainless steel that will add a rustic touch to your home. And since it is made out of stainless steel, you can be certain it is designed to withstand the test of time, just like the unfailing appeal of the barn door itself.

Features of the Sliding Barn Door Installation Kit:

  • Comes with all necessary hardware to install a wood barn door.
  • All 304 Grade Stainless Steel Construction.
  • Nylon covered wheel for silent operation.
  • Ball bearing wheel for a long lasting, smooth operation.

Specifications of the Oil Rubbed Bronze Finished Stainless Steel 234" Barn Door Hardware:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze On Satin Stainless Steel
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Track: 234"
  • For two 60" doors.

Package Includes:

  • Three 78"Stainless Steel Tubular Tracks And Connectors
  • Stainless Steel Wheel Sets
  • Floor Guide
  • Wall Mounts
  • 2 Endcaps
  • All necessary installation hardware.

Special Order Item. NOT Returnable.
